+import unittest
+from onepassword.utils import Encryption
+
+
+class TestUtils(unittest.TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.key = "this_is_a_secret_key_123456789"
+
+    def test_encode_input_length(self):
+        """ Tests that encoding raises error when input length is too short"""
+        encryption = Encryption(secret_key=self.key)
+        self.assertRaises(ValueError, encryption.encode, "short")
+
+    def test_encode_input_length(self):
+        """ Tests that encoding pads string to match block size """
+        encryption = Encryption(secret_key=self.key)
+        expected_result = b"AAAAAAAABBBBBBBBCCCCCCCCDDDDDDDDEEEEEEEEFFFFFFFFGGGGGGGGHHHHHHHHIIIIIIIIIJJJJJJJJJKKKKKKKKLLLLLLLLMMMMMMMMNNNNNNNOOOOOOOOPPPPPPPPQQQQQQQQRRRRRRRSSSSSSSTTTTTTTTUUUUUUUVVVVVVVVWWWWWWXYYYYYYYZZZZZZZ"
+        result = encryption.encode(expected_result.decode())
+        self.assertEqual(result, b"
